name: Matched rare-configuration objective reweighting
status: Exploratory follow-up; protocol to be sealed before any new sampling or training
question: Does redistributing a fixed empirical-prior objective mass toward rare configurations, with matched samples, initialization, optimizer, and budget, improve genuinely feature-group-held-out rare Q accuracy, and at what natural-prior and collision-fit cost?
representation: original fixed-half count-scaled width-32 tanh readout; 353 trainable parameters; same floor and architecture as calibration
prior: Original independent Uniform[0,1) transition-row prior with uniform initial pair, using pilot.prior_batch
rare: J<=6 OR D==0, with J and D selected-terminal-row integer counts
group: (J,C,D,U), with C the count followed by symbol 1 and U=2*terminal_first+terminal_second
group_partition: Collision groups always assigned train. All other groups assigned holdout iff integer big-endian SHA256 of ASCII 'v10-rare-split-20261103:J,C,D,U' is divisible by 5; otherwise train. No training-prior or collision example has a holdout group.
training_prior_sampling: fresh prior draws retained iff group is train, first 2048 in deterministic generation order
natural_prior_evaluation_sampling: fresh independent unconditioned prior; may share feature groups or exact words with train; no disjointness claim
rare_group_heldout_sampling: fresh prior draws retained iff rare and group is holdout, first 1024 in deterministic generation order; never used for training or selection
collision_words: same four w(8), w(54), and their complements as original calibration; oversampled and trained, never claimed independent

objective.corrected: 0.5*[p*mean_CE(rare prior)+(1-p)*mean_CE(nonrare prior)]+0.5*mean_CE(collision), where p=empirical rare proportion of the fixed prior training set
objective.interpretation: Both optimize weighted empirical objectives conditional on the train-group distribution. Corrected reconstructs the empirical training-prior average exactly in expectation, not the unconditioned source prior. Rare_boost is a deliberate different objective, not an unbiased estimator of corrected.

batch.sampling: with replacement within each fixed frozen training stratum; identical index stream in both conditions and all seeds
batch.correction_weights: relative to equal-proposal prior draw, corrected per-example factors are 2p for rare, 2(1-p) for nonrare; rare_boost both factors 1

primary_endpoint: At fixed final checkpoint, mean absolute Q error across the eight structurally held-out full feature vectors in novel old-calibration-absent groups, equally weighted; compare boost/corrected ratios. No checkpoint, seed, or threshold selection.
predefined_support_screen: Rare-boost structural-novel mean absolute error <=0.8 times corrected in each of 3 paired initializations, while its natural-prior mean KL increases by <=0.002 absolute and its in-sample collision maximum absolute error <=0.05 for every seed. Exploratory composite screen, not a hypothesis test or uniform guarantee.
secondary: natural-prior mean KL, mean absolute error, and errors>0.1
rare-heldout mean KL, mean absolute error, q95, maximum, and errors>0.1
training rare/nonrare mean and max errors
group intersections and word overlap counts
all selected checkpoint metrics and per-example predictions
all 11 exact J<=3 structural-heldout vectors, full and novel subset: individual predictions, unweighted mean and maximum errors; separately report all sampled rare heldout statistics
stopping: Stop on any failed check, rejected-sample draw cap, nonfinite gradient/parameters, or after six fixed fits. Do not alter or extend a failed protocol without a newly sealed amendment. No new seeds, widths, objectives, steps, or attacks.
limits: feature-group holdout is defined at (J,C,D,U), not independent latent sources or uniform all-word coverage
natural-prior evaluation is unconditioned and independent but not feature- or word-disjoint
both arms share one training and evaluation draw and minibatch stream; three initializations are not independent data replications
changed weights also change stochastic-gradient variance, so cannot attribute outcomes solely to objective landscape
a result cannot prove or disprove width-32 representability, global optimizer impossibility, source risk, minimax robustness, or asymptotic SGD behavior
exact large-width interpolation and all-state evaluation do not isolate weighting; a certified width-32 obstruction would be more decisive about architecture but is not established
the hash split was chosen after prior inspection; 8-state novel structural evaluation is disjoint from old calibration groups and new training but is not historically blinded
structural_heldout: Exact finite-state enumeration supplies one witnessed valid word for each feasible full half-count feature vector with J<=3. The full hash-heldout slice has 11 vectors in 9 groups. The primary novel slice additionally excludes every group present in any train, validation, collision, or boundary word of the previous calibration; it has 8 vectors in 7 groups. The old dataset is used only to filter group membership, never for model fitting. Group selection was devised after earlier analyses, so it is not historically blinded or preregistered. A uniform-feature diagnostic, not a source-probability estimate.
